title: Before You Cancel a Companion Fare Booking, Check the Code
caption:
Canceling an Alaska/Atmos cash companion-fare booking? Check the code’s expiration first.

Alaska’s companion-specific rule: if the code is unexpired when you cancel, it is redeposited with its original expiration. If it has expired, cancellation forfeits it. No fresh clock.

Tickets booked with companion-fare codes can be changed within applicable fare rules. Any ticket refund or credit depends on fare rules too—getting the code back is a separate matter.

Official rule: https://www.alaskaair.com/shared/tips/AboutDiscountCodes.aspx

Full article: https://practicalrewards.com/blog/before-you-cancel-a-companion-fare-booking-check-the-code-f20563.html

Check your code’s expiration and ticket terms. If anything is unclear, contact the airline before canceling.
